newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end 1.5 pct higher, gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end 1.5 pct higher, gains seen.

text.p: 1350 GMT - Austria's ATX index ended nearly 1.5 percent higher on Monday. Traders said the market was technically driven and see potential for a stab at 1,280 points in the coming days.
* 17 ATX gainers, three losers, one unchanged.
* Top gainer fireproof material maker Radex Heraklith RHIV up 4.51 pct at 533 ats
* Fibremaker Lenzing biggest decliner, down 0.42 pct at 704 ats.
* May ATX contract up 19.10 points at 1,259.0 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
